title: feat: rebuild the KPI dashboard on @pollinations/ui
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Ports `operations/kpi` onto the shared design system and cleans out the stale parts. Verified locally against live Tinybird/GitHub data (`npm run dev`, Basic auth, light + dark + 420px).

- Adds `@pollinations/ui` + React 19 — `AppHeader`, `Surface`, `StatCard`, `Table`, `Alert`, `InfoTip`, `ColorModeToggle` — matching `model-monitor` and `economics`. Drops `recharts`, `lucide-react`, `date-fns` and the local tailwind config.
- Charts are inline SVG/CSS on theme tokens, so both modes are stepped rather than flipped. The dual-axis tokens+revenue chart is split in two; y-axes fit the data range (labelled when they don't start at zero); hover crosshair, legends, end-of-line labels.
- Serves assets through the `[assets]` binding with `run_worker_first` instead of Workers Sites + `kv-asset-handler`; Basic auth still gates the SPA shell.
- Removes unused worker endpoints, including `/api/kpi/all`, which self-fetched without the auth header and always 401'd.
- Trims merged weekly data to 12 weeks — the pipes reach back different distances, so the trend table was rendering 46 mostly-empty columns.
- README rewritten: it documented a manual `wrangler login` deploy (contradicting the CI path) and a `scripts/load-secrets.sh` that does not exist.

Note: `DASHBOARD_PASSWORD` is still set by hand via `wrangler secret put` and is not in `secrets/env.json`. `wrangler secret bulk` does not delete unlisted secrets, so deploys keep it, but it is unrecoverable if lost.

gist.headline: The KPI garden got pruned
gist.blurb: The internal numbers garden has been replanted on the shared UI system. Fewer abandoned pipes, cleaner charts, and only twelve weeks of weeds to inspect.
gist.summary: Rebuilt the operations KPI dashboard on @pollinations/ui and React 19, replacing third-party charting with theme-aware inline SVG charts, serving assets through the Worker binding, and limiting merged weekly trends to 12 useful weeks.
gist.impact: Dashboard operators get a responsive light/dark KPI view with clearer dual-axis charts, working authenticated data flow, and trend tables without 46 mostly empty weekly columns.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy internal analytics garden: Polli tends a tidy chart-bed while a CRT monitor robot proudly displays two separated trend graphs with readable axes. The old overgrown columns have been pruned into a neat 12-week row, representing the dashboard cleanup and shared design-system rebuild.
